title: Heterogeneous Markups Cyclicality and Monetary Policy
title_primary: Heterogeneous Markups Cyclicality and Monetary Policy
authors: Andrea Chiavari, Marta Morazzoni, Danila Smirnov
official: 官方在线 2026-09-07 · 来源：RSS
abstract: This paper studies aggregate markup cyclicality through firm‐level heterogeneity, reallocation, and aggregation. Using the U.S. firm data for 1990–2016, we find that markups are procyclical for young firms and countercyclical for older firms following monetary policy shocks. Economic activity also reallocates modestly toward young firms. As the firm population ages, the aggregate markup response shifts from acyclical or mildly procyclical to countercyclical. These findings help reconcile conflicting evidence on markup cyclicality and imply that firm demographics shape monetary‐policy transmission and the roles of demand and supply shocks in business cycles.

title: Wealth and Property Taxation in the United States
title_zh: 美国财富与财产税研究
title_primary: 美国财富与财产税研究
title_secondary: Wealth and Property Taxation in the United States
authors: Sacha Dray, Camille Landais, Stefanie Stantcheva
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-09-04 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: We study the history and geography of wealth accumulation in the United States using newly collected historical property tax records from the early 1800s onward. These records come from the administration of the General Property Tax–a tax that aspired to cover all types of property. We construct wealth series at the state, county, and national levels. At the state level, we use annual assessed values of wealth from state-level reports drawn from multiple sources. Because assessed values may differ from market values, we also require assessment ratios, defined as the ratio of assessed to market wealth. We obtain state-level assessment ratios from decadal U.S. Census wealth data (drawn from various Census reports, including those on “Wealth, Debt, and Taxation”), in which the Census carried out detailed valuation work, complemented with information on changes in assessment practices from the state reports, to build higher-frequency series of assessment ratios. The result is long-run annual wealth series for states from 1850 (or earlier, depending on the state) to 1935. We obtain national wealth series by aggregating these state series. At the county level, we use assessed values (or market values where available) from the U.S. Census wealth data for each decade, and apply either state-level or county-level assessment ratios, where available, to obtain market values of wealth for each decade from 1850 to 1930. We use these data to show, first, that the United States experienced extraordinary wealth accumulation after the Civil War and until the Great Depression. Second, spatial inequality in the United States has been large and highly persistent since the mid-1800s. We also examine the determinants of long-term wealth growth and find, among other results, that counties with a higher share of enslaved property before the Civil War or with higher wealth inequality experienced lower subsequent long-run wealth growth.
abstract_zh: 我们利用自19世纪初起新收集的历史财产税记录，研究美国的财富积累历史与地理分布。这些记录源自一般财产税的管理实践——该税种旨在覆盖所有类型的财产。我们构建了州、县及国家层面的财富序列。在州级层面，我们依据多来源的州级报告中的年度评估价值。鉴于评估价值可能与市场价值存在差异，我们还需评估比率，即评估财富与市场财富之比。我们从十年一次的美国人口普查财富数据（包括“财富、债务与税收”等各类普查报告）中获取州级评估比率，普查中进行了详尽的估值工作，并辅以州报告中关于评估实践变化的信息，以构建更高频率的评估比率序列。由此，我们得到了各州从1850年（或更早，视州而定）至1935年的长期年度财富序列。国家财富序列则通过汇总这些州级序列获得。在县级层面，我们利用每十年美国人口普查财富数据中的评估价值（或可得情况下的市场价值），并应用州级或县级评估比率（若可得），以获取1850年至1930年间每十年的市场财富价值。利用这些数据，我们首先展示，美国在内战后至大萧条前经历了非凡的财富积累。其次，自19世纪中叶以来，美国的空间不平等显著且高度持续。我们还探讨了长期财富增长的决定因素，发现，在其他结果中，内战前奴隶财产占比更高或财富不平等更严重的县，其后续长期财富增长较低。

title: Beyond Optimization and Blind Selection: Reflexive Agency in Economic Evolution
title_zh: 超越优化与盲目选择：经济演化中的反思性能动性
title_primary: 超越优化与盲目选择：经济演化中的反思性能动性
title_secondary: Beyond Optimization and Blind Selection: Reflexive Agency in Economic Evolution
authors: Dennis Snower
official: 官方在线 2026-09-03 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: Evolutionary economics explains economic change through variation, selection, retention, transmission, innovation, and institutional transformation, whereas much of economics explains outcomes through purposive choice. This article argues that these modes of explanation become recursively connected once economic agents can represent the evolutionary processes in which they participate and intentionally alter their operation. It develops the concept of reflexive economic evolution: agents do not merely choose within given constraints or adapt to existing selection pressures, but can generate new possibilities, modify selection environments, organize transmission, and sometimes revise the criteria and mechanisms by which variants are selected. This latter second-order capacity is termed meta-selection. Reflexive economic evolution does not imply comprehensive control or a predetermined social end-state: guidance changes the distribution of possible trajectories under uncertainty rather than determining a trajectory. The framework shows how intentional and evolutionary explanations can be causally complementary, why effective agency is partly endogenous, and why policy should be understood not only as changing current outcomes but also as reshaping the evolutionary environment in which subsequent adaptation and innovation occur.
abstract_zh: 演化经济学通过变异、选择、保留、传递、创新及制度转型来解释经济变迁，而多数经济学则通过有目的的选择来解释结果。本文认为，一旦经济行为者能够表征其所参与的演化过程并有意识地改变其运作方式，这两种解释模式便会递归地相互关联。本文提出了反思性经济演化的概念：行为者不仅是在既定约束内进行选择或适应现有的选择压力，还能创造新的可能性、修改选择环境、组织传递，有时甚至修订变异被选择的标准与机制。这后一种二阶能力被称为元选择。反思性经济演化并不意味着全面控制或预设社会终极状态：引导改变的是不确定性下可能轨迹的分布，而非决定某条特定轨迹。该框架展示了意向性解释与演化解释如何在因果上互补，为何有效能动性部分内生于过程，以及为何政策应被理解为不仅改变当前结果，还重塑后续适应与创新所发生的演化环境。

title: Optimal monetary and exchange rate frameworks for commodity-exposed economies
title_zh: 大宗商品暴露经济体的最优货币与汇率框架
title_primary: 大宗商品暴露经济体的最优货币与汇率框架
title_secondary: Optimal monetary and exchange rate frameworks for commodity-exposed economies
authors: Thomas Drechsel, Michael McLeay, Silvana Tenreyro, Enrico D. Turri
official: 官方在线 2026-08-29 · 来源：RSS
abstract: We show that the optimal monetary and exchange rate frameworks depend critically on the economy’s commodity exposure. We develop a flexible but tractable model economy with commodity exports and imports, in which international financial conditions depend on the commodity cycle. Stabilizing domestic prices is optimal for commodity exporters, in line with standard open-economy policy prescriptions. But when economies import commodities as production inputs, optimal policy largely ‘looks through’ their direct and indirect effects on domestic prices. In emerging economies, where financial conditions are closely related to commodity cycles, trade-offs are starker and limited credibility may make implementing optimal policy challenging.
abstract_zh: 我们证明，最优的货币与汇率框架在很大程度上取决于经济体的商品敞口。我们构建了一个灵活但易于处理的经济模型，包含商品出口与进口，其中国际金融状况随商品周期而变化。对于商品出口国而言，稳定国内价格是最优选择，这与标准开放经济政策建议相符。但当经济体将商品作为生产投入品进口时，最优政策在很大程度上“透视”其对国内价格的直接与间接影响。在新兴经济体中，金融状况与商品周期紧密相关，权衡更为严峻，而有限的信誉可能使实施最优政策面临挑战。

title: Centralization vs. Decentralization: First Evidence from the Laboratory
title_zh: 集中化与分散化：来自实验室的首个证据
title_primary: 集中化与分散化：来自实验室的首个证据
title_secondary: Centralization vs. Decentralization: First Evidence from the Laboratory
authors: Gabriele Camera, Gary Charness, Nir Chemaya
official: 官方在线 2026-08-26 · 来源：RSS
abstract: The future architecture of financial systems is a subject of contention, with centralized and decentralized governance proponents. Here, we ask the following question. Would the architecture affect the quality of decision making? We propose a game where financial network participants demarcate the ownership of claims to income. This governance task can be decentralized (shared authority), centralized (single authority), or hybrid (alternating authority). Without communication, all architectures supported poor outcomes. With communication, decentralization ensured good governance and maximum profits, whereas centralization did not—lowering communication’s potency in promoting socially optimal decisions. This indicates that there is scope for decentralization in innovating financial institutions. This paper has been accepted by Camelia Kuhnen for the Virtual Special Issue on Digital Finance. Funding: N. Chemaya acknowledges partial financial support from the NET Institute. Supplemental Material: The online appendix and data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2025.02314 .
abstract_zh: 金融体系的未来架构是一个争议性话题，支持者分别主张集中治理与分散治理。在此，我们提出以下问题：架构是否会影响决策质量？我们构建了一个博弈模型，其中金融网络参与者界定对收入索取权的归属。这一治理任务可以采取分散化（共享权威）、集中化（单一权威）或混合型（交替权威）形式。在没有沟通的情况下，所有架构均导致不良结果。而在存在沟通时，分散化确保了良好治理并实现利润最大化，而集中化则未能如此——削弱了沟通在促进社会最优决策方面的效力。这表明，在金融制度创新中，分散化具有潜在空间。本文已被Camelia Kuhnen接受，收录于数字金融虚拟特刊。资助信息：N. Chemaya感谢NET研究所的部分财务支持。补充材料：在线附录及数据文件可在 https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2025.02314 获取。

title: Do Ryder Cup captains randomize? Evidence from Sunday singles orders
title_zh: 莱德杯队长是否随机安排？来自周日单打顺序的证据
title_primary: 莱德杯队长是否随机安排？来自周日单打顺序的证据
title_secondary: Do Ryder Cup captains randomize? Evidence from Sunday singles orders
authors: Daniel A. Dias
official: 官方在线 2026-08-26 · 来源：RSS
abstract: Professional sports offer rare field tests of game theory with observed choices, sharp incentives, and expert competitors. Ryder Cup Sunday singles is a simultaneous permutation game where captains order twelve players and pairings form slot by slot. Under Hurley (2002)’s benchmark, uniform random ordering is a mixed-strategy equilibrium of the constant-sum game, and therefore also a minimax strategy. Using Sunday singles orders from 1981–2025 and, where available, Data Golf and OWGR ranks before each Cup, I test whether within-team ability is assigned uniformly at random across lineup slots. Permutation tests reject uniform random assignment. The data indicate that stronger players appear earlier than random shuffles within teams predict, with the pattern more pronounced in later Ryder Cups.
abstract_zh: 职业体育为博弈论提供了罕见的实地检验场景，其中包含可观测的选择、明确的激励以及专家级竞争者。莱德杯周日单打赛是一种同时进行的排列博弈，队长们安排十二名球员出场顺序，配对逐位形成。在Hurley（2002）的基准框架下，均匀随机排序是该常和博弈中的混合策略均衡，因此也是极小化极大策略。利用1981年至2025年间的周日单打出场顺序，并在可获得的情况下结合每届杯赛前的Data Golf和OWGR排名，我检验了队内能力是否在各出场位次上被均匀随机分配。排列检验拒绝了均匀随机分配的假设。数据表明，较强球员在队内随机洗牌所预测的位次之前更早出场，且这一模式在后期的莱德杯中更为显著。

title: DP20893 Risk Sharing and Incentives: Public Insurance Versus Bankruptcy Protection
title_zh: 风险分担与激励：公共保险与破产保护
title_primary: 风险分担与激励：公共保险与破产保护
title_secondary: DP20893 Risk Sharing and Incentives: Public Insurance Versus Bankruptcy Protection
authors: Torben M Andersen, Joydeep Bhattacharya, Min Wang
official: 官方在线 2025-12-06 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: This study compares public social insurance and consumer bankruptcy in a life-cycle model. Without moral hazard, public insurance dominates by providing superior consumption smoothing. However, with moral hazard, bankruptcy protection becomes optimal. Its exemption levels, priced into competitive credit contracts, internalize incentive distortions and can Pareto dominate public insurance. The two policies are strategic substitutes, offering little added benefit when combined. The key trade-off is between public insurance's better risk-sharing and bankruptcy's superior management of incentive problems.
abstract_zh: 本研究在生命周期模型中比较了公共社会保险与消费者破产制度。在无道德风险的情况下，公共保险通过提供更优的消费平滑而占优。然而，在存在道德风险时，破产保护成为最优选择。其豁免水平被定价于竞争性信贷合同中，内化了激励扭曲，并可能在帕累托效率上优于公共保险。这两种政策为策略性替代品，结合使用时几乎无额外增益。关键权衡在于公共保险更优的风险分担与破产制度对激励问题的更佳管理之间。

title: The marriage squeeze: How the college gender gap is reshaping who marries whom
title_zh: 婚姻挤压：大学性别差距如何重塑婚配格局
title_primary: 婚姻挤压：大学性别差距如何重塑婚配格局

authors: Clara Chambers, Benjamin Goldman, Joseph Winkelmann
official: 官方在线 2026-08-09 · 来源：RSS
abstract: Today, 1.6 million more women than men are enrolled in four-year colleges and universities in the US, raising concerns that college-educated women will struggle to find suitable partners. This column presents evidence that college women have in fact sustained relatively stable marriage rates, in part by increasingly marrying non-college men. This pattern, combined with the economic decline of non-college men, has reduced the pool of economically stable partners for non-college women. The findings raise the question of whether policies that improve outcomes for less-educated men could also narrow class gaps in marriage and family formation.
abstract_zh: 如今，美国四年制学院和大学中，女性入学人数比男性多出160万，引发了对受过大学教育的女性难以找到合适伴侣的担忧。本专栏提供的证据表明，大学女性实际上维持了相对稳定的结婚率，部分原因在于越来越多地与非大学男性结婚。这一模式，加上非大学男性经济状况的下滑，减少了非大学女性中经济稳定伴侣的储备。研究结果提出了一个问题：改善教育程度较低男性境遇的政策，是否也能缩小婚姻和家庭形成中的阶级差距。

title_zh: 城市与性：人口结构、空间分选与婚姻市场

authors: Min Fang, Zibin Huang, Yushi Wang, Yu (Alan) Yang
official: 官方在线 2026-07-27 · 来源：RSS
abstract: We study how the interaction between demographic changes and spatial sorting affects marriage matching across space. Using data from China, we first present stylized facts on the diverging spatial distribution of singlehood characterized by a high singles rate for females (males) in more (less) developed cities. We then build a quantitative spatial equilibrium model. It reveals that more highly educated women sort into the service sector in more developed cities than men. With persistent social norms of hypergamy, this results in more failed marriage matches for females (males) in more (less) developed cities, thereby lowering the national marriage rate.
abstract_zh: 本文研究人口结构变化与空间分选之间的相互作用如何影响跨区域的婚姻匹配。利用中国数据，我们首先呈现了单身现象空间分布分化的典型事实：在较发达城市，女性单身率较高；而在欠发达城市，男性单身率较高。随后，我们构建了一个定量空间均衡模型。模型揭示，相较于男性，更多高学历女性倾向于在较发达城市的服务部门集聚。在持续存在的“上嫁”社会规范下，这导致较发达城市中女性婚姻匹配失败率上升，而欠发达城市中男性婚姻匹配失败率上升，进而降低了全国婚姻率。

title: DP21780 Life After Divorce: Effects of Joint Custody on Parents and Children
title_zh: 离婚后的生活：共同监护对父母与子女的影响
title_primary: 离婚后的生活：共同监护对父母与子女的影响
title_secondary: DP21780 Life After Divorce: Effects of Joint Custody on Parents and Children
authors: Stella Canessa, Gordon Dahl, Anna Hasselqvist, Costas Meghir, Susan Niknami 等
official: 官方在线 2026-07-23 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: Divorce reshapes family life, yet little is known about one of its most consequential features: the allocation of child custody. We study the impact of joint versus sole custody on both parents and children using rich administrative data from Sweden linked to over 25 years of newly-collected court custody rulings. To address selection concerns, we exploit random assignment of custody disputes to judges who differ sharply in their propensity to grant joint custody. For fathers, joint custody substantially raises earnings and improves mental health, consistent with sustained paternal involvement enhancing labor market attachment and psychological well-being. In contrast, there are no measurable labor market or mental health effects for mothers. Turning to children, joint custody increases standardized test scores and school quality without affecting mental health outcomes. Joint custody increases fathers’ chances of remarriage, keeps separated parents in closer geographic proximity, and has no effect on intimate partner violence allegations against either partner. These findings inform longstanding debates over the role of child custody in shaping post-divorce family life.
abstract_zh: 离婚重塑了家庭生活，然而其最具深远影响的特征之一——子女监护权的分配——却鲜为人知。我们利用瑞典超过25年新收集的法院监护权裁决数据，结合丰富的行政记录，研究了共同监护与单独监护对父母及子女的影响。为应对选择偏差问题，我们利用监护权争议案件随机分配给法官的机制，这些法官在授予共同监护权的倾向性上存在显著差异。对父亲而言，共同监护显著提高了其收入并改善了心理健康，这与持续的父亲参与增强劳动力市场依附性和心理幸福感的结果一致。相比之下，母亲在劳动力市场或心理健康方面未观察到可测量的影响。就子女而言，共同监护提高了标准化考试成绩和学校质量，但未影响心理健康结果。共同监护增加了父亲再婚的可能性，使分居父母保持更近的地理距离，且未对任何一方的亲密伴侣暴力指控产生影响。这些发现为关于监护权如何塑造离婚后家庭生活的长期争论提供了依据。

authors: Hanbaek Lee
source: Journal of the European Economic Association
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-07-13 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: This paper studies how large firms’ synchronized lumpy investments endogenously shape an economy’s fragility to negative TFP shocks. I develop a heterogeneous-firm real business cycle model that matches the empirical interest rate elasticities of investment for both large and small firms. In the model, large firms’ lumpy investments become persistently synchronized due to their low sensitivity to general equilibrium effects, generating investment surges. Following these surges, TFP-induced recessions are particularly severe, and the semi-elasticity of aggregate investment drops significantly, consistent with the data.
abstract_zh: 摘要 本文研究大型企业同步化的大额投资如何内生地塑造经济对负向全要素生产率冲击的脆弱性。我构建了一个异质性企业真实商业周期模型，该模型能够匹配大型企业与小型企业投资对利率的实证弹性。在模型中，大型企业的大额投资因对一般均衡效应敏感度较低而持续同步化，从而引发投资激增。这些激增之后，全要素生产率冲击引发的衰退尤为严重，且总体投资的半弹性显著下降，这与数据表现一致。

title: The perceived inflation wedge: Why households experience inflation differently from official statistics
title_zh: 感知通胀差距：为何家庭对通胀的感受与官方统计不同
title_primary: 感知通胀差距：为何家庭对通胀的感受与官方统计不同
title_secondary: The perceived inflation wedge: Why households experience inflation differently from official statistics
authors: Neville Francis
official: 官方在线 2026-07-06 · 来源：RSS
abstract: Households often report inflation perceptions and expectations that differ markedly from official measures. This column proposes a new measure of perceived inflation, which uses disaggregated inflation data with indicators for household attention to capture the prices that people actually notice. The difference between perceived and official inflation varies over time and becomes particularly pronounced during periods of economic stress. Heightened attention to inflation is persistent and can remain elevated even after official inflation measures improve. As central banks recognise the importance of household beliefs for macroeconomic outcomes, it becomes important to also understand the gap between measured and perceived inflation.
abstract_zh: 家庭通常报告的通货膨胀感知和预期与官方指标存在显著差异。本文提出了一种新的感知通胀衡量方法，该方法利用分类通胀数据及家庭关注度指标，以捕捉人们实际注意到的价格变化。感知通胀与官方通胀之间的差异随时间推移而变化，在经济压力时期尤为显著。对通胀的高度关注具有持续性，即使在官方通胀指标改善后仍可能保持高位。随着央行认识到家庭信念对宏观经济结果的重要性，理解衡量通胀与感知通胀之间的差距也变得至关重要。

title: Local Determinacy in Incomplete-Markets Models
title_zh: 不完全市场模型中的局部确定性
title_primary: 不完全市场模型中的局部确定性
title_secondary: Local Determinacy in Incomplete-Markets Models
authors: Marcus Hagedorn
source: Journal of Economic Dynamics and Control
official: 官方在线 2026-07-09 · 来源：RSS
abstract: This paper proposes the first methodology for assessing local determinacy in incomplete-markets models. My simple determinacy criterion yields theoretical results and can be verified numerically. It merely requires calculating aggregate marginal propensities to consume (MPC) and aggregate elasticities of asset demand. I find that the policy rules ensuring determinacy can be quite different in incomplete as opposed to complete-markets models. My methodology can thus avoid the current (flawed) practice of referring to complete markets results to assess determinacy in incomplete markets models. The main findings are: If bonds are nominal, the economy is always determinate for a constant nominal interest rate or for price level targeting if prices are sufficiently rigid. The model is indeterminate if fiscal policy is too expansionary, requiring a monetary policy response to reestablish determinacy. If bonds are real, whether or not the Taylor principle induces determinacy depends non-linearly on MPCs, the degree of price rigidities and whether interest rates respond to output. I also find the determinacy properties of active and passive fiscal rules (Leeper, 1991) to be different in incomplete and complete markets models. I explain the shortcomings in Kaplan et al. (2023), which are the reason for their different and thus invalid findings.
abstract_zh: 本文提出了在不完全市场模型中评估局部确定性的首个方法论。这一简洁的确定性准则既能推导出理论结果，也可通过数值方法验证，仅需计算总边际消费倾向（MPC）与总资产需求弹性。研究发现，相较于完全市场模型，不完全市场模型中确保确定性的政策规则可能存在显著差异。因此，本方法论可避免当前（存在缺陷的）将完全市场结论套用于不完全市场模型确定性评估的实践。主要发现如下：若债券为名义债券，在名义利率恒定或价格水平目标制下（当价格具有充分刚性时），经济始终具有确定性；若财政政策过度扩张，模型将出现不确定性，此时需通过货币政策响应重建确定性。若债券为实际债券，泰勒原理能否引发确定性取决于MPC、价格刚性程度及利率是否对产出做出反应的非线性关系。此外，本文发现主动与被动财政规则（Leeper, 1991）在完全市场与不完全市场模型中的确定性特征存在差异，并阐释了Kaplan等（2023）研究中的缺陷——正是这些缺陷导致其结论存在差异且无效。

title: GLP-1–Induced Weight Loss and the Female Obesity Penalty
title_zh: GLP-1诱导的体重减轻与女性肥胖惩罚
title_primary: GLP-1诱导的体重减轻与女性肥胖惩罚
title_secondary: GLP-1–Induced Weight Loss and the Female Obesity Penalty
authors: Rebecca Diamond
official: 官方在线 2026-06-29 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: GLP-1 medications generate large weight loss and may also alter social and economic outcomes. Using the Understanding America Study, I compare women starting GLP-1s for weight loss with matched women who would like to start a GLP-1 but have not. Single women’s marriage/cohabitation rates rise by 29 percentage points and employment among baseline non-employed women rises 27 percentage points after six or more quarters. Existing partnerships do not dissolve, and already-employed women show no upward job mobility. The pattern suggests that part of the female obesity penalty operates at new-match formation rather than only through health or incumbent productivity.
abstract_zh: GLP-1药物能显著减轻体重，并可能改变社会与经济结果。利用《理解美国研究》数据，我将因减重而开始使用GLP-1的女性与匹配的、有意愿但尚未使用GLP-1的女性进行比较。在六个季度或更长时间后，单身女性的婚姻/同居率上升29个百分点，基线未就业女性的就业率上升27个百分点。现有伴侣关系并未瓦解，而已就业女性未表现出向上职业流动性。这一模式表明，女性肥胖惩罚的部分作用机制在于新匹配关系的形成，而非仅通过健康或现有生产力途径实现。

title: School feeding, maternal empowerment, and household consumption
title_zh: 学校供餐、女性赋权与家庭消费
title_primary: 学校供餐、女性赋权与家庭消费
title_secondary: School feeding, maternal empowerment, and household consumption
authors: Guanfu Fang, Tianyuan Luo, Benyu Qian
official: 官方在线 2026-06-22 · 来源：RSS
abstract: This paper examines the causal effects of a school feeding program on maternal empowerment and household consumption in rural China. Exploiting the staggered implementation of the Student Nutrition Improvement Program, we find that the program significantly reduces maternal time spent on housework, improves maternal labor market performance, and enhances maternal decision‐making power within nuclear households. The augmented bargaining power translates into shifts in household consumption toward female‐prioritized goods, including more nutritious foods, clothing, and housework‐related appliances. However, these positive effects on maternal empowerment are diminished in multigenerational families, where grandparents can assist with childcare responsibilities.
abstract_zh: 本文考察了学校供餐计划对中国农村地区女性赋权及家庭消费的因果效应。利用学生营养改善计划的分阶段实施，我们发现该计划显著减少了母亲的家务劳动时间，改善了母亲在劳动力市场的表现，并增强了母亲在核心家庭中的决策权。这种议价能力的提升促使家庭消费转向女性优先商品，包括更营养的食品、衣物及家务相关电器。然而，在多代同堂的家庭中，由于祖父母可协助承担育儿责任，这些对女性赋权的积极影响有所减弱。

title: Long-Term Health and Human Capital Effects of Universal Health Care and Mass Literacy: Evidence from Cuba
title_zh: 全民医保与大规模扫盲的长期健康及人力资本效应：来自古巴的证据
title_primary: 全民医保与大规模扫盲的长期健康及人力资本效应：来自古巴的证据
title_secondary: Long-Term Health and Human Capital Effects of Universal Health Care and Mass Literacy: Evidence from Cuba
authors: Giovanni Mellace, Rok Spruk
official: 官方在线 2026-06-15 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: We estimate long-run effects of Cuba's 1961 National Health Service and contemporaneous National Literacy Campaign using synthetic-control methods on newly assembled series for 21 former European colonies in the Americas, 1900--2022. Relative to synthetic Cuba, infant mortality falls 15--29 percent and average years of schooling rise 1.5--2 years; both effects are large, persistent, and robust to augmented SCM, synthetic difference-in-differences, interactive fixed effects, and matrix completion. Life-expectancy gains attenuate after 1990, consistent with the post-Soviet Special Period, suggesting that bundled health and literacy reforms permanently raise early-life survival and human capital, with smaller and less robust effects on adult longevity.
abstract_zh: 我们利用合成控制法，基于新编制的1900—2022年美洲21个前欧洲殖民地的序列数据，估算了古巴1961年国家卫生服务与同期全国扫盲运动的长期效应。与合成古巴相比，婴儿死亡率下降15%—29%，平均受教育年限增加1.5—2年；这两个效应均显著、持久，并在增强型合成控制法、合成双重差分法、交互固定效应模型及矩阵补全方法中保持稳健。预期寿命的改善在1990年后有所减弱，这与后苏联时期的“特殊时期”相一致，表明捆绑式的卫生与扫盲改革永久性地提高了早期生存率与人力资本，但对成人寿命的影响较小且稳健性较弱。

title: Unpacking Aggregate Welfare in a Spatial Economy
title_zh: 空间经济中的总福利解构
title_primary: 空间经济中的总福利解构
title_secondary: Unpacking Aggregate Welfare in a Spatial Economy
authors: Eric Donald, Masao Fukui, Yuhei Miyauchi
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-06-05 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: How do regional productivity shocks or transportation infrastructure improvements affect aggregate welfare? In a general class of spatial equilibrium models, we provide a formula for aggregate welfare changes, decomposed into terms associated with (i) technology [Fogel (1964), Railroads and American Economic Growth (Baltimore: Johns Hopkins Press), Hulten (1978) “Growth Accounting with Intermediate Inputs”, The Review of Economic Studies, 45, 511–518], (ii) spatial dispersion of marginal utility, (iii) fiscal externalities, (iv) technological externalities, and (v) redistribution. We further use this decomposition to derive a general formula for optimal spatial transfers and show that, whenever optimal transfers are in place, the technology term alone captures the aggregate welfare effects of technological shocks. We apply our framework to study welfare gains from improving the US highway network. We find that changes in the spatial dispersion of marginal utility are as important as technological externalities in accounting for the deviations from the Fogel-Hulten benchmark to assess welfare gains.
abstract_zh: 区域生产率冲击或交通基础设施改善如何影响总体福利？在一类通用的空间均衡模型中，我们推导出总体福利变化的分解公式，该公式包含以下组成部分：(i) 技术效应 [Fogel (1964), 《铁路与美国经济增长》(巴尔的摩：约翰·霍普金斯出版社)；Hulten (1978)《中间投入的增长核算》，《经济研究评论》，第45卷，511–518页]；(ii) 边际效用的空间分散程度；(iii) 财政外部性；(iv) 技术外部性；以及(v) 再分配效应。我们进一步利用该分解推导出最优空间转移支付的一般公式，并证明当最优转移支付机制存在时，仅技术效应项即可完全捕捉技术冲击对总体福利的影响。我们将该分析框架应用于评估美国高速公路网络改善带来的福利收益，发现边际效用空间分散程度的变化与技术外部性在解释福利收益偏离Fogel-Hulten基准时具有同等重要性。

title: Sustainability and the Reallocation of Production Across Grazing Regimes in Livestock Systems: Evidence From Mexico
title_zh: 可持续性与畜牧系统中放牧模式间生产的重新配置：来自墨西哥的证据
title_primary: 可持续性与畜牧系统中放牧模式间生产的重新配置：来自墨西哥的证据
title_secondary: Sustainability and the Reallocation of Production Across Grazing Regimes in Livestock Systems: Evidence From Mexico
authors: Saúl Basurto‐Hernández, Allan Beltrán, Luis Peña‐Lévano
official: 官方在线 2026-05-28 · 来源：RSS
abstract: Changes towards more sustainable livestock production are often evaluated in terms of whether farms abandon environmentally harmful practices. Less attention has been paid to how farms reallocate production across alternative grazing systems and how the composition of production evolves over time. This paper addresses this question by modelling grazing systems as compositional outcomes and examining how financial, institutional and structural factors shape the distribution of livestock across alternative regimes. We use farm level data from the 2007 and 2022 agricultural censuses in Mexico, covering more than 860,000 cattle farms and estimate a fractional multinomial logit model. Financial and institutional support is associated with economically meaningful reductions in free grazing. However, most of this adjustment occurs through confinement rather than controlled grazing. Heterogeneity analysis reveals that small and dairy farms allocate a larger share of production to confinement systems, whereas large and beef‐dairy farms allocate relatively more to controlled grazing. The results indicate that sustainability outcomes depend on how policy instruments interact with farm scale, production orientation and land constraints.
abstract_zh: 向更可持续的畜牧业转型的评估通常聚焦于农场是否放弃环境有害的生产方式，而较少关注农场如何在替代放牧系统间重新配置生产，以及生产结构如何随时间演变。本文通过将放牧系统建模为组合结果，考察金融、制度和结构因素如何影响牲畜在不同生产模式间的分布，从而探讨这一问题。我们利用墨西哥2007年和2022年农业普查中超过86万个牧场的微观数据，估计了分数多项逻辑模型。研究发现，金融与制度支持与自由放牧在经济意义上的显著减少相关，但这一调整主要通过圈养而非控制放牧实现。异质性分析表明，小型牧场和奶牛场将更大比例的生产配置于圈养系统，而大型牧场及肉奶兼用牧场则相对更多采用控制放牧。结果表明，可持续性成效取决于政策工具如何与农场规模、生产导向及土地约束相互作用。

title: How does FDI transmit into domestic investment? Exploring intra-industry and financial channels
title_zh: 外商直接投资如何传导至国内投资？——行业内部与金融渠道的探索
title_primary: 外商直接投资如何传导至国内投资？——行业内部与金融渠道的探索
title_secondary: How does FDI transmit into domestic investment? Exploring intra-industry and financial channels
authors: Tim de Leeuw, Konstantin M. Wacker
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-01-24 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: Foreign direct investment (FDI) is often seen as a means to boost domestic investment and, hence, capital accumulation. Yet, the empirical support for such a positive investment effect of FDI is inconclusive. A possible reason is that FDI is often directed towards the financial sector, where capital investment tends to be low. In this paper, we develop a novel approach to analyse how FDI into the financial sector transmits into domestic investment by non-financial industries. Our approach uses shares of industries’ financial exposure to attribute shifts in financial FDI to individual non-financial industries. Using industry-level FDI and investment data from 12 Central and Eastern European countries between 1997 and 2019, we find that industries with close links to the financial sector increase domestic investment in the presence of financial FDI, particularly manufacturing, trade and real estate. Additionally, we provide suggestive evidence that this relationship operates through a liquidity channel.
abstract_zh: 外国直接投资（FDI）常被视为促进国内投资、进而推动资本积累的一种手段。然而，关于FDI对投资具有积极效应的实证支持并不确定。一个可能的原因是，FDI往往流向金融部门，而该部门的资本投资通常较低。本文开发了一种新颖的方法，用以分析流入金融部门的FDI如何传导至非金融行业的国内投资。我们的方法利用各行业金融敞口的份额，将金融FDI的变动归因于各个非金融行业。利用1997年至2019年间12个中东欧国家的行业层面FDI和投资数据，我们发现，与金融部门联系紧密的行业在金融FDI存在时增加了国内投资，尤其是制造业、贸易和房地产业。此外，我们提供了初步证据表明，这种关系通过流动性渠道发挥作用。

title: Asset Elasticities and Currency Risk Transfer
title_zh: 资产弹性与货币风险转移
title_primary: 资产弹性与货币风险转移
title_secondary: Asset Elasticities and Currency Risk Transfer
authors: Carol Bertaut, Ester Faia, Sebnem Kalemli-Ozcan, Camilo Marchesini, Simon Paetzold 等
official: 官方在线 2025-09-22 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: We use administrative security-level data from the U.S. and Euro Area (EA) portfolios to estimate asset demand and supply elasticities by exploiting exogenous variation in bond-specific currency wedges. Employing a Bartik-style shift-share identification approach, we document extensive heterogeneity in investor demand responsiveness to exogenous changes in the price of currency risk, conditional on the issuer characteristics. Demand for AE-bonds is always inelastic, whereas for EM-bonds, elasticity depends on investor type and currency: insurance/pension, nonbanks and banks have finite-elastic demand for EM-bonds that are issued in their own (investor) currency. For EM-issuer-currency bonds, only EA non-bank investors increase the share of these bonds in their portfolio when currency wedges widen, suggesting they accept higher currency risk for higher returns. In response, issuers adjust their supply endogenously: an exogenous increase of 8 basis point in currency wedges leads to a 0.26% decline in local currency bond issuance relative to GDP. We develop a theoretical framework where debt issuance decisions take into account heterogenous demand of investors in terms of their response to changes in the price of currency risk.
abstract_zh: 我们利用美国和欧元区投资组合的行政安全级数据，通过挖掘债券特定货币楔子的外生变动，估计资产需求与供给弹性。采用巴蒂克式转移份额识别方法，我们发现，在给定发行人特征条件下，投资者需求对货币风险价格外生变化的响应存在显著的异质性。对发达经济体债券的需求始终缺乏弹性，而对新兴市场债券而言，弹性取决于投资者类型和货币：保险公司/养老基金、非银行机构和银行对以其自身（投资者）货币发行的新兴市场债券具有有限弹性需求。对于以新兴市场发行人货币计价的债券，当货币楔子扩大时，只有欧元区非银行投资者会增加此类债券在其投资组合中的占比，表明他们为获取更高回报而接受更高的货币风险。作为回应，发行人内生调整其供给：货币楔子每外生增加8个基点，本币债券发行量相对于GDP下降0.26%。我们构建了一个理论框架，其中债务发行决策需考虑投资者对货币风险价格变化响应的异质性需求。

title: How digital credit platforms impact the ability of businesses to raise finance?
title_zh: 数字信贷平台如何影响企业融资能力
title_primary: 数字信贷平台如何影响企业融资能力
title_secondary: How digital credit platforms impact the ability of businesses to raise finance?
authors: Yuanbin Xu Yani Wang Yuchen Wang Xin Zeng Fucai Lu School of Digital Economics, Jiangxi University of Finance and Economics, Nanchang, China
official: 官方在线 2025-07-30 · 来源：RSS
abstract: Employing panel data from Chinese-listed enterprises from 2002 to 2022 within a quasi-natural experiment framework of digital social credit platforms, this study examines big data’s impact on corporate financing through public credit information. Findings indicate that these platforms alleviate financing constraints, expand funding scale and enhance efficiency. Mechanisms include the mitigation of adverse selection, reduction of default risk and optimization of resource allocation through credit structure and cost adjustments. Public credit information is shown to improve financial environments, thereby strengthening financing capacity. Heterogeneity analyses reveal differential impacts: benefits are amplified for firms with established credit records; manufacturing entities and those in low-competition markets experience constraint alleviation; significant scale and efficiency gains are observed in eastern regions, demonstrating pronounced geographical variation. This research elucidates digital platforms’ role in modern finance and supports deeper digital-real economy integration.
abstract_zh: 本研究利用2002至2022年中国上市企业面板数据，在数字社会信用平台的准自然实验框架下，探讨大数据通过公共信用信息对企业融资的影响。研究发现，这些平台缓解了融资约束，扩大了融资规模并提升了效率。其机制包括缓解逆向选择、降低违约风险以及通过信用结构和成本调整优化资源配置。公共信用信息被证明能改善金融环境，从而增强融资能力。异质性分析揭示了差异化影响：对于信用记录完善的企业，益处更为显著；制造业实体及低竞争市场中的企业经历了约束缓解；东部地区在规模与效率上取得显著提升，显示出明显的地域差异。本研究阐明了数字平台在现代金融中的作用，并支持数字经济与实体经济更深层次的融合。
